company.shortDescription: Artisan AI is a software development company that develops AI-powered employees to automate workflows across various business functions.
company.description: Artisan AI is a software development platform that develops AI-powered digital employees to automate workflows across various business functions, with a particular focus on outbound sales. Its flagship product, Ava, is an AI-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) that automates tasks such as lead discovery, research, personalized email sequences, and multi-channel outreach, allowing sales teams to concentrate on building relationships.
